name: Portable Backup
purpose: Selective local export, inspect-before-restore comparison, and safe merge.
runtime_data: User-selected local folders and application data
Ignored local safety copies created before explicit replacement
removal: Remove modules/backup and the Settings backup wiring; personal archives remain ordinary ZIP files.
safety: Preview and restore use the same validated plan.
Archive paths remain inside their selected destination.
Existing files are preserved by default.
Explicit replacement creates an ignored local safety copy first.
